title: PIAIC | Saylani Welfare
text: The Presidential Initiative for Artificial Intelligence and Computing (PIAIC) partners with Saylani Welfare to provide high-end tech education. This program offers specialized courses in Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing, Blockchain, and Internet of Things (IoT), aiming to train students to become leaders in emerging technology fields. PIAIC is a separate national initiative (launched with government backing) that runs some of its classes out of Saylani campuses, including Saylani's Bahadurabad head office and Gulshan campus, alongside its own PIAIC-run centers; it is distinct from, but complementary to, Saylani's own SMIT courses. Admission to PIAIC is via PIAIC's own entrance exam and registration process (piaic.org), separate from SMIT's enroll.saylanimit.com registration.
